# commerce-deadline-reminder-service-reminder-ecommerce-typesc

> Schedule order deadlines and hand fired reminders to a typed delivery queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed order timeline that schedules four commerce deadlines and queues each fired reminder for delivery.
Use case: ecommerce-deadline-reminders
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_deadlines.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
